plan.scope: Saved six maps only; <=2 CPU threads; no inference, CT/checkpoint loading, repository changes, or live run access.
plan.grid: 128 square tiles; stride64; regular native starts plain 64k, padded y=64k-40 and x=64k-200. Append length-128 final start. Hann nonperiodic outer product normalized and floored .001; weighted average encoded uint8. Geometric schedule only: actual occupancy subset cannot independently be reconstructed without CT.

distance to nearest potential tile-start line on either axis, separately plain and padded grids, bins0..4,5..12,13..20,21..32

plan.stopping: One calculation, arithmetic validation, one figure and concise interpretation. No frequency search, threshold sweep, p-values, accuracy or causal claim; no rank overlap duplication.
plan.limits: With overlap there is no unique stitched seam at a grid line. Occupancy and raw texture unavailable; spatial confounding remains. Source code verified but no inference rerun. Boxes overlap and are preexposed. Final edge tiles break periodicity; phase plots use interior population.
